answer: A cedar stake works like a bond: each agent locks real collateral before it can trade, and the stake is slashed if it cheats, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand real bonds. Reputation then grows like a vine, slowly, only through completed verified work, so new identities start untrusted and cannot jump the queue. An umber audit trail of every bond and trade makes that cost visible to all, so Sybil farming stays unprofitable.
